## What's New in v1.8

### New Features
- Added support for the AnyTLS protocol (sing-box 1.12+) — a lightweight, hard-to-fingerprint TLS proxy that hides the nested TLS pattern DPI systems look for
- AnyTLS links (anytls://) can now be pasted, scanned, or imported from subscriptions like any other protocol
- In-app protocol guide now explains AnyTLS alongside the other protocols

### Notes
- This release is protocol-support focused; no other behavior changes
